statusDefinitions.absent: No production implementation for the stated capability in this cell.
statusDefinitions.implemented: A connected source path exists; this is not proof of end-to-end correctness.
statusDefinitions.integration-tested: The stated bounded production composition has executed with retained evidence; limits are explicit.
statusDefinitions.release-qualified: Exact final host/guest/runtime tuples pass full release gates; no cell currently has this status.

cells.meaning: Production Hypervisor.framework vCPU owner is DoryHV.Machine; the newer native engine is a probe client.
Managed direct boot and ARMVirt UEFI compose into the production runner; stock install/reboot is not qualified.
Managed disk identities and backing/transport code are connected; host durability and guest filesystem workload qualification remain open.
Connected bounded host networking; Mac builder currently installs NAT. Isolation/policy variants and guest I/O durability need cell-specific qualification.
ARM/PC use the isolated filesystem worker with conservative zero-cache/non-DAX behavior; Mac uses granted VZ shared directories. Full coherence/performance remains P11.
VirGL2/ANGLE/Metal and Venus/MoltenVK/Metal worker paths exist on managed ARM; exact stock-media application API qualification remains open.
Connected host presentation path; output is software display on PC. A frame or view does not establish GPU API acceleration.
Host keyboard/pointer plumbing is connected; release/focus/overflow/resynchronization guest vectors remain open.
Host audio backends are connected for each cell; device semantics, latency, loss and per-VM permission/policy qualification remain open.
Linux coordinator requires explicit policy and guest helper capabilities; Mac has SPICE clipboard wiring. Formats, lifecycle and requested-policy parity remain unqualified.
Authenticated agent/vsock/control paths and packaging exist; cross-version guest installation and everyday workflows remain open.
Public durable suspend requires Apple Virtualization with VZ control; raw-HV/DBT pause is not durable memory suspend.

Public cold file-snapshot/restore and authenticated helper recovery passed P01 signed controlled-helper campaigns; this does not establish physical guest memory continuation or application consistency.

Public cold file-snapshot/restore and authenticated helper recovery passed P01 signed controlled-helper campaigns; this does not establish physical guest memory continuation or application consistency.
Interpreter and baseline JIT exist; false Xen facilities and unqualified feature semantics remain P02 findings. Serial vCPU scheduling is not parallel SMP throughput.
PVH/UEFI paths exist. First-slice firmware readiness is not userspace readiness; pinned userspace boot has not passed.
